sections.name: VillageBackground
sections.title: Animated village background
sections.what: Connects the page's canvas and host box to the shared drawing engine when the page opens, and disconnects them when the page closes. Renders the box and canvas that the engine paints on.
sections.why: Likely reason: the drawing runs in a shared engine, and this component only hooks it into the page. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The cleanup must keep running on unmount, otherwise the engine keeps drawing into removed elements.

summary: Places an animated village drawing behind the home page by connecting a canvas element to a shared drawing engine.
purpose: Gives the home page a decorative animated background.
why: Likely reason: keeps the drawing logic in one shared engine instead of inside each page. Reason not stated in the code.
how: When the page loads, it finds the host box and the canvas, asks the shared engine to start drawing into them, and stores a cleanup function. When the page unmounts, the cleanup runs and stops that drawing.
inputs: The page loads this component with no arguments. It reads the host box and canvas from its own references.
outputs: A background box with a canvas that the drawing engine paints. Nothing is sent or saved.
risks: If the cleanup does not run, the engine keeps drawing into removed elements, which wastes processor time. The background is hidden from screen readers by design.
debug: If the background is blank, check that the canvas exists and that the engine registration is called. If the page is slow, check whether the cleanup runs when navigating away.
